messages:
Jules (Vendor): Hi team — sending invoice INV-2026-045 for month of Feb. It's a consolidated invoice covering 3 shipments across different POs. Link: https://invoices.vendorco.com/INV-2026-045 :paperclip:
Lina (Finance Ops): Thanks Jules. I don't see any PO number on the PDF. Can you confirm PO(s) or cost centers? We need PO matching to route approvals.
Jules (Vendor): Sorry — we grouped three internal orders. POs are 4501, 4502, and 4503 but the invoice is single file. Our system doesn't split by default.
Matt (AP): That will break our PO-match rule and queue it for manual review. Manual holds delay payment. Can vendor reissue split invoices per PO?
Jules (Vendor): We can split. ETA ~2 business days to generate three separate invoices. Will that work?
Lina (Finance Ops): 2 days ok but we also need the correct GL mapping per PO. @Anna (Procurement) can you confirm GL and approver for 4502?
Anna (Procurement): 4501 -> GL 6003 (Cloud Services), approver @matt, 4502 -> GL 6100 (Professional Services), approver @lina, 4503 -> GL 6200 (Hardware). Vendor should put PO in invoice header and a line-level PO reference if possible.
Matt (AP): If vendor can't split immediately, short-term workaround: we can create a temporary umbrella PO so AP can process partial payment and avoid full hold. But procurement approval is required to create umbrella PO.
Anna (Procurement): I can create a temporary PO (TEMP-9001) but we need vendor to accept payment to TEMP-9001 and sign a statement saying remaining charges will be re-invoiced.
Jules (Vendor): We can accept TEMP-9001 and will reissue the 3 invoices within 48 hours. Provide the statement template if you have one.
Lina (Finance Ops): Attach vendor statement template: https://redwood.internal/docs/ap/vendor-ack-template.docx
Matt (AP): I'll put the invoice on hold until TEMP-9001 is created or we get split invoices. Holding note: "INV-2026-045 — awaiting split or temporary PO"
AP-bot: New invoice INV-2026-045 attached to vendor VendorCo, amount $34,500 — status: pending_manual_review.
Jules (Vendor): Quick Q — will a partial payment be possible for the hardware line (4503) before the splits? That's $10k.
Anna (Procurement): We can prioritize hardware if vendor provides split or at least a signed statement and the mapping: 
```
4503 -> $10,000 -> GL 6200 -> Approver: @lina
```
If vendor signs, AP can process that line once TEMP-9001 or split exists.
Lina (Finance Ops): Also flagging: when vendor reissues, please include invoice metadata in the file name: INV-2026-045_4501.pdf etc. That helps our OCR.
Matt (AP): I'll create the payment hold and note next steps in Coupa. @Anna please ping when TEMP-9001 created so I can route payment.
Anna (Procurement): Will do. ETA: creating TEMP-9001 now, should be live in ~1 hour.
Jules (Vendor): Thanks, we'll sign the statement and send a signed PDF within the hour, then follow up with split invoices in 48 hours.
Lina (Finance Ops): Great — action items: 1) @Anna create TEMP-9001, 2) @Jules send signed vendor ack, 3) @Matt hold invoice and tag in AP, 4) vendor to submit split invoices within 48h.
Matt (AP): Noted. I'll mark payment pending and set a follow-up reminder for 3 days.
Jules (Vendor): Appreciate the quick help.
Lina (Finance Ops): Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
